identity.name: Big Crown Pointer Date
identity.one_liner: The pointer-date complication on a coin-edge Aviator case — the only series-production automatic with a center-hand date complication at this price point.

narrative.story: The Big Crown Pointer Date pairs Oris's 754 caliber (a Sellita SW200-1 with an in-house pointer-date module) with the 1938 Big Crown aviation case — the coin-edge bezel and the oversized crown are the 1938 originals. The pointer-date complication — a fourth hand that points to a date scale on the dial periphery — is rare in series production and unique at this price. The Big Crown Pointer Date is the most-cited Oris non-diver and the watch a collector cites when they want a complication no Swiss competitor offers at the $2,200 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The pointer-date module is an in-house Oris design on a Sellita base. The Big Crown line dates to 1938; the coin-edge bezel and oversized crown are original design elements.
